name: nintendo-best-selling-hardware-top-five

angle.hook: Switch is Nintendo's best-selling hardware ever, 157.20 million, ahead of the DS by about 3.2 million
angle.why_now: evergreen: Nintendo's figures as of 30 Sep 2026, published with the 5 Nov results
angle.players_here: Switch and DS are what many readers grew up on; Switch 2 is the one on shelves in the Gulf now
angle.payoff: four of the five are handhelds or hybrids, and Switch 2 (26.35 million) is still climbing
